copy.curiosityHook: Seeking a fresh start with his brother, Danila is pushed into the line of fire. Will he realize what Victor is hiding before the hit is carried out?
copy.description: Arriving in Petersburg to build a fresh life with his successful brother, Danila discovers Victor is in hiding from mob fallout—and gets steered into executing a lethal contract hit in his place.
copy.vibeSummary: Grim, suspenseful Russian crime drama with heavy emotional weight, measured pacing, and steady engagement suited for solitary viewing.
copy.whyWatch: Aleksei Balabanov crafts a grounded, tense Russian crime drama where family loyalty turns hazardous, balancing grim street-level suspense with heavy emotional consequence.

allowedMaterial: Danila arriving in Petersburg to start a new life
Victor secretly being a contract killer in hiding
Victor convincing Danila to assassinate a Chechen mob boss in his place
Setting, genre elements, and tonal weight
excludedMaterial: Later plot reversals, deaths, or ending events
